article_title: Mum's viral barefoot race sparks debate over India's education crisis

tasks.prompt: How does the article connect Ramabai's race to a wider public debate?
options: Her win highlights the sacrifices families make for education and questions whether support reaches them
Her win proves all Indian education is free
The race was held to choose new police officers
It shows coaching centres are unnecessary
tasks.correct_answer: Her win highlights the sacrifices families make for education and questions whether support reaches them
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה משתמשת בסיפור הריצה כדי לדון בעלויות הלימודים, בתחרות וביישום התמיכה הציבורית.

tasks.prompt: Why did Ramabai remove her slippers during the race?
options: They were banned by the race organisers
They kept slipping off as she ran
She wanted to donate them to her daughter
A coach told her she had to run barefoot
tasks.correct_answer: They kept slipping off as she ran
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכפכפים החליקו מרגליה, ולכן היא הסירה אותם ורצה יחפה.

tasks.prompt: What does “striking a nerve” mean in the account of the viral video?
options: Causing a physical injury
Preventing people from watching
Touching a sensitive issue that provoked a strong response
Making a racing rule invalid
tasks.correct_answer: Touching a sensitive issue that provoked a strong response
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מציין שהסרטון נגע בסוגיה חברתית רגישה ועורר תגובות.

tasks.prompt: What does “sole breadwinner” mean in the description of Ramabai?
options: The only family member who cooks
A professional runner
The only person who studies
The family's only provider of income
tasks.correct_answer: The family's only provider of income
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לאחר מות בעלה רמבאיי הייתה היחידה שפרנסה את המשפחה.

tasks.prompt: How much was Ramabai's race prize, and what did she hope it would buy?
options: 3,000 rupees to buy books and study materials
50,000 rupees to pay for a university degree
3,000 rupees to buy running shoes
A full scholarship for both daughters
tasks.correct_answer: 3,000 rupees to buy books and study materials
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפרס היה 3,000 רופי ונועד לסייע בקניית ספרים וחומרי לימוד.

tasks.prompt: What does “implementation remains weak” mean in Thorat's criticism of education schemes?
options: No support schemes have ever been announced
Existing schemes are not effectively reaching people in practice
Every student has already received enough money
The schemes are run solely by athletes
tasks.correct_answer: Existing schemes are not effectively reaching people in practice
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ת׳וראט טוען שיש תוכניות אך יישומן בפועל אינו מגיע לאנשים במידה מספקת.

tasks.prompt: Identify two routes to government work that Ramabai's daughters are preparing for.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את המשטרה ואת שירות המדינה; אין לטעון שכבר התקבלו לעבודה.

tasks.prompt: Why does the 3,000-rupee prize not settle the family's education needs?
expected_points: The article says it is far below the cost of higher education
Even a coaching course would cost more than the prize could cover
Books and examination preparation create ongoing expenses
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשוות בין סכום הזכייה להוצאות המתמשכות, בלי לקבוע סכומים שלא נמסרו.

tasks.prompt: Summarise Ramabai's race, her motivation and the debate it sparked.
expected_points: She ran a 3km community race barefoot without training
She wanted money for her daughters' education
She won 3,000 rupees, enough to help with materials but not higher education
Her story raised questions about competition and costs
Thorat criticised weak implementation of support schemes
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את הסיפור ואת הדיון המבני, בהפרדה בין עובדות לפרשנות.

tasks.prompt: Explain why the article contrasts individual determination with structural educational barriers.
expected_points: Ramabai worked after her husband's death and left school at 13
She wants better opportunities for her daughters
Government examinations are highly competitive and preparation costly
Alleged paper leaks have weakened faith in the system
A former education official says support schemes are poorly implemented
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב פסקה באנגלית עם ראיות אישיות ומערכתיות, בלי להציג טענות על הדלפות כעובדה מוכחת.
